TYPE CHECK: The candidate value is a numeric count, which is the correct category for technical replicates.
SOURCE CHECK: The paper states "each sample was measured in triplicate in DDA and DIA mode", which refers to the MS acquisition of the samples.
TRUTH CHECK: The text explicitly mentions "triplicate" measurements for each sample. However, in proteomics, "measured in triplicate" often refers to biological replicates unless specified as technical replicates of the same digest. In this study, the "five different samples" (spike-in states) were each measured three times. These are typically treated as biological replicates in the context of the experimental design (5 states x 3 replicates = 15 runs). There is no mention of additional technical replicates (e.g., splitting one digest into multiple injections) per biological replicate.
COMPLETENESS CHECK: The value "3" is the only one extracted, but it likely refers to biological replicates, not technical replicates.
